objective: Discover a hard-valid, explainable ML strategy whose realistic after-cost Bybit account growth materially exceeds the current project-wide first place, then update the cumulative ranking if warranted.
economic_hypothesis: A directional path delivered through many small, sign-consistent completed returns is more likely to continue after its first deep but structurally valid OTE pullback, while a path dominated by one or two discontinuous jumps is more likely to overreact and traverse the opposing frozen liquidity pool first. One calibrated model must decide between continuation and reversal from causal path quality, flow, volatility, cross-asset breadth and frozen upper/lower liquidity geometry.

allowed_motivation: Da, Gurun and Warachka continuous-information hypothesis published before 2024
pre-2024 cryptocurrency momentum, reversal, jump and liquidity literature
SMC/ICT external-liquidity, displacement and 50%-79% OTE concepts translated into deterministic completed-bar rules
explicitly_excluded_from_rule_definition: 2026 Price Path Continuity and the Cross-Section of Cryptocurrency Returns
future model labels, future first-passage outcomes or future MFE/MAE

event_definition.entry_time: next exact contiguous 15-minute Bybit contract open
event_definition.source_gap_policy: rolling state resets after missing bars; no forward fill across source gaps

liquidity_pool_definition.selection: nearest candidate strictly beyond next-open entry by at least 20bp
liquidity_pool_definition.label: which frozen pool is touched first after entry
liquidity_pool_definition.same_bar_both_touch: AMBIGUOUS for model fitting and adverse stop-first for account replay
liquidity_pool_definition.unresolved: CENSORED for model fitting; blocks the account and fails promotion if unresolved at evaluation end

model.calibrator: one IsotonicRegression fitted only on calibration resolved labels
model.decision_rule: LONG, SHORT or FLAT from calibrated upper-first probability, frozen pool distances, 18bp round-trip cost and 10bp minimum expected edge

execution.target_fill: frozen target price, never a more favorable intrabar price
execution.risk_search_condition: opened only if the unchanged 2%-risk signal path passes every base economic and robustness gate

conditional_sequential_rule.model_update: at each half-year start refit the same fixed HGBT on all resolved rows ending before the most recent six months and fit the same isotonic calibrator on the most recent completed six months; existing positions remain governed by their frozen pools
conditional_sequential_rule.ranking_comparison: insert into the cumulative ranking only after hard-valid account metrics are normalized and compared to all recorded candidates

prohibitions: No model-family, feature, event-threshold, pool, EV, risk or leverage change after opening an outcome partition.
No 2024-2026 download unless every pre-2024 gate passes.
No target-return fitting, forced daily profit target or elapsed-time liquidation.
No credentials, private endpoint, paper, testnet or live order.
